HELP_DASHBOARD:
The Dashboard is the main control panel.

- Top: Quick totals for the current month and your balance.
- Pie chart: Shows which concepts are draining your money this month.
- Quick view: Below the pie chart you now have a fast list of this month's active expenses.
- Trend graph: Compares the last 6 months so you can spot your financial direction.
HELP_TRANSACTIONS:
Manage your transactions here.

- One-time: Single usage operations.
- Recurring: The app projects this expense mechanically every month.
HELP_CATEGORIES:
Create master labels to classify your movements.

- Choose a color and set whether it works for 'Income' or 'Expense'.
HELP_COMMITMENTS:
Commitments monitor large fragmented payments.

- Payment Plan: Mechanically creates recurrences.
- Contribution: Direct payment to reduce pending balance.
HELP_HISTORIC:
The Time Machine of your savings.

- Total Tab: General overview.
- Annual Tab: Comparison segmenting data by year.
HELP_HEALTH:
Welcome to your Economic Thermometer.

- 50/30/20 Rule: 50% Needs, 30% Leisure, 20% Savings.
- Score: If you meet the criteria, you'll score 100/100.

MANUAL_Q1_A: Shark is an extreme local-first financial ecosystem. It is designed to centralize cash flow with zero-telemetry and maximum privacy. Our philosophy is to give you total control without a single byte of your data leaving your machine without permission.
MANUAL_Q2_A: Your data (names, amounts, and notes) is encrypted at rest using the AES-256 algorithm. This means if someone steals your database file, they will only see unreadable noise. Only your master password can unlock the vault.
MANUAL_Q3_A: If you suspect physical intrusion, you can trigger Self-Destruction in Settings. This will wipe the database, all program folders, and unlink system shortcuts. It also triggers after 5 failed password attempts.
MANUAL_Q4_A: Record every movement with custom categories. Remember: Income feeds your health, Expenses evaluate it. Use categories to segment needs and wants logically.
MANUAL_Q5_A: A 'Commitment' is a long-term financial goal (mortgage, car, travel savings). You can create monthly payment plans or one-time contributions. The system mathematically predicts when you'll finish based on your current pace.
MANUAL_Q6_A: Shark applies the Harvard rule by default: 50% Needs, 30% Wants, 20% Savings. Your score (0-100) evaluates your monthly balance. Staying in the green range ensures a healthy retirement or emergency fund.
MANUAL_Q7_A: You can carry Shark on a USB. Use 'Export Local Database' in Settings to move data between machines. When starting the app on a new machine, just enter your master password to decrypt everything.
MANUAL_Q8_A: If you want to enter expenses from the couch, you can use Remote Deployment with Docker. You have a built-in installer that uploads the app to a server. Plus, once deployed, your PC's desktop app and the web server will magically sync automatically (Cloud Save) every time you open or close the PC app.
MANUAL_Q9_A: We recommend backing up your `budget_app.db` file weekly. If you forget your password, use the Security Question defined at setup to recover access to the master key.
MANUAL_Q10_A: Data Sovereignty: Your data is yours, not ours. Local Privacy: No telemetry or trackers. Right to be Forgotten: Physical wipe button. Transparency: No hidden costs or subscriptions.
MANUAL_Q11_A: Shark Accounting is distributed under the MIT license. You may use, copy, modify, and redistribute the software as long as you keep the copyright notice and this license. The Shark Accounting name, the SharkIT alias, logos, and visual identity are not covered by this license and may not be reused in a way that creates confusion without explicit authorization.

HELP_SAVINGS: Piggy Banks allow you to save for specific goals. When you 'Contribute', an expense is recorded in your general history (money leaves your pocket) but accumulates here. If you check 'No ceiling', there will be no limit or progress bar, just a cumulative counter.
MANUAL_Q12_A: Unlike commitments, savings goals serve to accumulate money. Every contribution counts as an expense in the monthly balance so you don't count on that money in your day-to-day, but it is displayed here as progress towards your goal. You can have goals with a 'ceiling' (e.g., buying a phone) or 'no ceiling' (e.g., infinite emergency fund).
MANUAL_Q13_A: The crown jewel of Docker deployment. When you deploy the server from 'Server Center', your linked app and the Server enter into Symbiosis. When you turn on your PC, it downloads new data from the server (what you entered on mobile). When you close the PC app, it uploads everything to the server. Without touching anything, your data is always optimized and up to date.
